posts.body:
Hello,
There doesn't seem to be any
plugin or lunatic command
to change a battler's CTB icon during combat, using YEP CTB plugin on MV.
Would such a change possible and if so how would you go about it?
Or is everything loaded at the start and can't be updated afterwards?
Thank you!

posts.author: Showsni
posts.body:
ShadowDragon said:
what battler's CTB icon?
Click to expand...
The icons that appear in the top right when you're using Yanfly's CTB plugin, each person in the fight has an icon representing them.
You could try using a script call to manually update your actor's .ctbIcon to the new icon number; I don't know if that would work, or even if it would update midfight or not. I guess it would be something like
Code:
$gameActors.actor(1).ctbIcon = 1
? Maybe?
